operations.name: get_organisation
operations.description: Get Xero organisation profile: name, base currency, country, edition, tax settings, financial year end, and next invoice/credit note/PO numbers.

operations.name: list_accounts
operations.description: List the chart of accounts (code, name, type, class, tax type). Optional filter by account type (REVENUE, EXPENSE, BANK, etc.).

operations.name: list_tax_rates
operations.description: List tax rates with tax type, effective rate, applicability flags, and components.

operations.name: list_branding_themes
operations.description: List invoice branding themes (id required for invoice creation).

operations.name: list_purchase_orders
operations.description: List purchase orders: number, supplier, status, total, currency, and date.
